metadata.title: Phase 7 BatchNorm Attack Frozen Detector Evaluation and Severity Audit

detector_audit.tradeoff_protection_mechanism: delta_rec_normal=+0.3704 (from 0.63 to 1.00) triggered clinical benefit because all predictions collapsed to Class 0 (Normal), even though delta_rec_pneumonia=-0.9743 collapsed to 0.00 and total validation loss increased by +0.2081.
detector_audit.explanation: The malicious hospital 0 is classified as NORMAL because: (1) Anomaly features (Z-scores, norms, cosines, trajectories) are computed strictly over trainable parameter tensors (indices 0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 14, 15, 16, 17) which are identical to honest updates; (2) Counterfactual validation evaluation loads all 18 tensors, including the poisoned BatchNorm floating buffers, causing activations to saturate and predict Class 0 for 100% of validation images; (3) This artifactual surge in Normal recall (+40% to 100%) activates Symmetrical Clinical Trade-Off Protection (delta_rec_normal > 0.0), which suppresses validation-loss degradation from triggering MALICIOUS or SUSPICIOUS.
